title: Foodweb predator-prey edges (16-guild model)
description: Edge list defining trophic interactions in the 16-guild MIMES foodweb. Each row pairs a predator guild with a prey guild plus a natural-language description and a Utility flag. Drives the FoodWebDiagram Sankey rendering directly (replacing its current synthetic placeholder edges).
notes: DRAFTED 2026-05-12 — high-leverage: feeds the FoodWebDiagram visual component. Coexists with the 18-guild variant; current Marine UI uses the 16-guild model.
